// AUTO-GENERATED by puerto. Edit puerto.toml, then run `puerto generate bootstrap`.
use std::sync::Arc;

use business::application::customer::create_customer::CreateCustomerUseCaseImpl;
use business::application::customer::delete_customer::DeleteCustomerUseCaseImpl;
use business::application::customer::get_customer::GetCustomerUseCaseImpl;
use business::application::customer::list_customers::ListCustomersUseCaseImpl;
use business::application::customer::update_customer::UpdateCustomerUseCaseImpl;

use business::domain::customer::repository::CustomerRepositoryTrait;
use infrastructure::customer::repository::PgCustomerRepository;

use business::application::user::login::LoginUseCaseImpl;
use business::application::user::logout::LogoutUseCaseImpl;
use business::application::user::register_user::RegisterUserUseCaseImpl;
use business::domain::user::repository::UserRepositoryTrait;
use infrastructure::db::auth::{PgCredentials, PgSessions};
use infrastructure::user::repository::PgUserRepository;
use poem::Endpoint;
use poem::EndpointExt;
use poem_openapi::OpenApiService;
use puerto_core::auth::{Authenticator, CredentialStore, PasswordHasher};

use crate::api::auth::routes::AuthApi;
use crate::api::customer::routes::CustomerApi;
use crate::api::me::routes::MeApi;

/// The routes, wired. An error is what stopped the startup: `main` prints it and exits 1.
pub async fn build_app(config: puerto_web::Config) -> Result<impl Endpoint, String> {
    let database_url = std::env::var("DATABASE_URL").map_err(|_| {
        "DATABASE_URL is not set — set it in .env (.env.example has one)".to_string()
    })?;
    let pool = infrastructure::db::create_postgres_pool(&database_url)
        .await
        .map_err(|e| format!("{e} — is the database up? `make docker-compose/up`"))?;
    infrastructure::db::run_migrations(&pool, &infrastructure::db::MIGRATOR)
        .await
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    // Accounts in this database (ADR-0021 § 2): their sessions are what every `BearerAuth` asks.
    let users: Arc<dyn UserRepositoryTrait> = Arc::new(PgUserRepository::new(pool.clone()));
    let credentials: Arc<dyn CredentialStore> = Arc::new(PgCredentials::new(pool.clone()));
    let hasher: Arc<dyn PasswordHasher> = Arc::new(puerto_auth::local::Argon2Hasher::new());
    let sessions = Arc::new(PgSessions::new(
        pool.clone(),
        infrastructure::db::auth::session_ttl_from_env()?,
    ));
    let authenticator: Arc<dyn Authenticator> = sessions.clone();
    let auth_api = AuthApi {
        register_user: Arc::new(RegisterUserUseCaseImpl {
            users: Arc::clone(&users),
            credentials: Arc::clone(&credentials),
            hasher: Arc::clone(&hasher),
        }),
        login: Arc::new(LoginUseCaseImpl {
            users,
            credentials,
            hasher,
            sessions: sessions.clone(),
        }),
        logout: Arc::new(LogoutUseCaseImpl { sessions }),
    };
    let me_api = MeApi;

    let customer_repo: Arc<dyn CustomerRepositoryTrait> =
        Arc::new(PgCustomerRepository::new(pool.clone()));
    let create_customer = Arc::new(CreateCustomerUseCaseImpl {
        repository: Arc::clone(&customer_repo),
    });
    let get_customer = Arc::new(GetCustomerUseCaseImpl {
        repository: Arc::clone(&customer_repo),
    });
    let list_customers = Arc::new(ListCustomersUseCaseImpl {
        repository: Arc::clone(&customer_repo),
    });
    let update_customer = Arc::new(UpdateCustomerUseCaseImpl {
        repository: Arc::clone(&customer_repo),
    });
    let delete_customer = Arc::new(DeleteCustomerUseCaseImpl {
        repository: customer_repo,
    });
    let customer_api = CustomerApi {
        create_customer,
        get_customer,
        list_customers,
        update_customer,
        delete_customer,
    };

    let ready = puerto_web::health::probe(move || {
        let pool = pool.clone();
        async move { infrastructure::db::ping(&pool).await }
    });

    // `app.rs` is the project's own: middleware and routes added there wrap everything here.
    Ok(crate::app::configure(puerto_web::routes(
        openapi_service((customer_api, me_api, auth_api)),
        &config,
        ready,
    ))
    // What every `BearerAuth` asks.
    .data(authenticator))
}

/// The API service, built in one place: whatever else reads its spec (the export test of a project
/// with `web/`) sees the API the server answers.
fn openapi_service<T: poem_openapi::OpenApi>(api: T) -> OpenApiService<T, ()> {
    OpenApiService::new(api, env!("CARGO_PKG_NAME"), env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    use business::domain::customer::use_cases::create_customer::mocks::MockCreateCustomerUseCase;
    use business::domain::customer::use_cases::delete_customer::mocks::MockDeleteCustomerUseCase;
    use business::domain::customer::use_cases::get_customer::mocks::MockGetCustomerUseCase;
    use business::domain::customer::use_cases::list_customers::mocks::MockListCustomersUseCase;
    use business::domain::customer::use_cases::update_customer::mocks::MockUpdateCustomerUseCase;
    use business::domain::user::use_cases::login::mocks::MockLoginUseCase;
    use business::domain::user::use_cases::logout::mocks::MockLogoutUseCase;
    use business::domain::user::use_cases::register_user::mocks::MockRegisterUserUseCase;

    /// The API contract the frontend's types are generated from (`make web/sync`).
    const OPENAPI_JSON: &str = concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/../docs/api/openapi.json");

    /// Built from mocked use cases: no server, no database. A missing file is written; a different
    /// one fails — run `make web/sync` (it sets `UPDATE_OPENAPI=1`) and commit the diff.
    #[test]
    fn openapi_spec_matches_docs_api_openapi_json() {
        let customer_api = CustomerApi {
            create_customer: Arc::new(MockCreateCustomerUseCase::new()),
            get_customer: Arc::new(MockGetCustomerUseCase::new()),
            list_customers: Arc::new(MockListCustomersUseCase::new()),
            update_customer: Arc::new(MockUpdateCustomerUseCase::new()),
            delete_customer: Arc::new(MockDeleteCustomerUseCase::new()),
        };
        let me_api = MeApi;
        let auth_api = AuthApi {
            register_user: Arc::new(MockRegisterUserUseCase::new()),
            login: Arc::new(MockLoginUseCase::new()),
            logout: Arc::new(MockLogoutUseCase::new()),
        };
        let spec = openapi_service((customer_api, me_api, auth_api)).spec();

        let path = std::path::Path::new(OPENAPI_JSON);
        if std::env::var_os("UPDATE_OPENAPI").is_some() || !path.exists() {
            let dir = path.parent().expect("docs/api/openapi.json has a parent");
            std::fs::create_dir_all(dir).expect("create docs/api");
            std::fs::write(path, &spec).expect("write docs/api/openapi.json");
            return;
        }
        let committed = std::fs::read_to_string(path).expect("read docs/api/openapi.json");
        assert!(
            committed == spec,
            "docs/api/openapi.json is not the API this code serves: run `make web/sync`"
        );
    }
}
